page.layout: One printed page. Running head/page number at top centre. Main text in one column: a title in capitals and italic dedication lines, then a paragraph of text. Below the text a date line and a signature line with a woodcut initial and a printed line to its right, then the secretary's name at the right.

main_text.head: MAXIMILIANVS, DEI GRATIA ROMANORVM IMPERATOR electus,

p.i: Honorabili nostro & Imperii fideli dilecto Bilibaldo Pirckheymer Consiliario nostro.

main_text.p: HOnorabilis, fidelis, dilecte, Currum Triumphalem, quem ad Triumphum nostrum ornandum excogitasti, ac per Albertum Dürer designare curasti, una cum expositione per harum latorem accepimus, ac diligenter inspeximus, summeque nobis placuit, & inventio tua, & animi promptitudo, meritoque te pro tanto beneficio summa complectimur benivolentia, & omni officio prosequemur. Datum in civitate nostra Inspruck, die xxix. Martii, Anno salutis M. D. XVIII. Regni vero nostri xxxii.

page.notes: The woodcut initial at the lower left is a decorative flourish initial (ornamented capital) and is not transcribed as text. The line "Ad Mandatum Cæsareæ Majestatis proprium" is set in italic and is the secretary's attestation; "Westner." is the secretary's name. Printed page number "162" appears at the top. Possible doubtful readings: "Dürer" and the "[?]" marks are not needed; the transcription follows the scan. The date "die xxix. Martii" appears as printed in the scan as "die x x 1 x.Martii", read here as xxix.; reading uncertain at the line end.
